keyword: why are we going back to the moon

verifications.claim: NASA's Artemis program spearheads the return to the Moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Nasa's Artemis II mission is sending four astronauts on their way to the Moon" (R1); "Under its Artemis program... NASA has real momentum... for one of the most ambitious human space flight efforts" (R3); "NASA’s Artemis II mission, which will send four astronauts around the Moon" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly identify NASA's Artemis program as leading the return to the Moon.

verifications.claim: The lunar South Pole contains water ice.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "substantial amounts of water at the poles... craters that are permanently in shadow, where ice can build up" (R1); "the lunar poles have at least 600 billion kilograms of water ice" (R3); "The moon's south pole is a prime location for water ice" (R4); "south pole region, where water ice has been confirmed" (R8)
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly confirm water ice at the lunar South Pole.

verifications.claim: Water ice at the lunar South Pole can be extracted for drinking water, breathable oxygen, and rocket fuel.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "provides drinking water, but can also be split into hydrogen and oxygen to provide air... and even fuel for spacecraft" (R1); "hydrogen and oxygen — can be used as rocket propellant" (R3); "harvest the moon's water... make drinking water, oxygen and rocket fuel" (R4)
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly state water ice can be used for drinking water, oxygen/air, and fuel/propellant.

verifications.claim: NASA plans to perfect habitats, power systems, and life-support technology on the Moon before undertaking the journey to Mars.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "On a Moon base, Nasa can perfect the tech to provide the air and water astronauts need. They'll have to work out how to generate power and build habitats"... "Paving the way to Mars" (R1); "establishing an enduring presence on the moon... steppingstone to Mars"... nuclear reactor... habitats (R3); "test new technologies... sustain human life... preparing for future missions to Mars" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly describe perfecting habitats, power, and life-support (air/water) on the Moon as preparation for Mars.

verifications.claim: China is pursuing a robust lunar program.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "China has been making fast progress... landed robots and rovers on the Moon, and says it will get humans there by 2030" (R1); "China wants to land its own astronauts on the moon before 2030" (R4); "China plans to land astronauts on the Moon by 2030, build a base" (R5)
verifications.reasoning: Sources describe China's advanced lunar landings, human plans, and base ambitions.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission will test habitats, power systems, and life-support technology in deep space.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: "Artemis II mission is sending four astronauts on their way to the Moon. Their voyage around our nearest neighbour will pave the way for a lunar landing" (R1); "Artemis II is testing the astronauts’ crew capsule, Orion... data on space radiation, microgravity... confinement" (R6); no mention of habitats, power systems, or life-support testing on Artemis II
verifications.reasoning: Sources describe Artemis II as a crewed flyby testing Orion/SLS, radiation, and isolation, not habitats/power/life-support which are for lunar surface/base.

verifications.claim: The Artemis II mission paves the way for landing the first woman and the first person of color on the lunar surface in subsequent missions.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Their voyage... will pave the way for a lunar landing" (R1); "NASA’s Artemis II mission... laying the groundwork for a lunar landing" (R5); "Christina Koch, the first woman ever to voyage to the Moon, Victor Glover, the first African American"... "land astronauts on the Moon with Artemis IV" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm Artemis II paves way for landings; its crew includes first woman/POC to lunar vicinity, with landings (first woman/POC) in subsequent missions.
